What we do

Our roofing services

From a single slipped slate to a full re-roof, we cover the lot. Tell us what is happening and we will tell you honestly what it needs.

Roof repairs

Slipped slates, cracked tiles, leaks and storm damage put right quickly and cleanly.

New roofs

Full re-roofs in slate or tile, stripped back, felted, battened and finished properly.

Flat roofing

EPDM rubber and GRP fibreglass flat roofs on extensions, dormers and garages.

Guttering and fascias

Gutters, fascias, soffits and downpipes cleared, repaired or replaced in full.

Chimney work

Repointing, rebuilds, flashing and capping to stop damp coming in at the stack.

Lead work

Lead flashing, valleys and soakers replaced where old lead has failed or lifted.

Before and after

Roof transformations

Real jobs, start to finish. The clips play as you reach them, and you can drag the sliders to compare before and after.

Project 01

Full re-roof with solar and roof windows

Stripped back to the rafters, re-timbered where needed, then finished in slate with integrated solar panels and roof windows set flush into the covering. New ridge, new dry verge and a fresh gutter line the full length.

  • Full strip and re-roof
  • Slate
  • Solar integration
  • Roof windows
Before After
Project 02

New roof structure and slate covering

Fresh rafters cut and set out over a rebuilt gable, then felted, battened and slated through. Dry ridge, dry verge and a clean edge detail all the way round so there is nothing sitting there waiting to fail in a few winters.

  • New rafters
  • Gable rebuild
  • Slate covering
  • Dry ridge

Why us

Why choose E Stewart Roofing

Roofing is one of those jobs where you only find out how good it was years later. Here is how we make sure you are not the one finding out the hard way.

Insured and accountable

A limited company you can look up, with insurance in place before anyone goes up a ladder.

We turn up

You get a time, and we are there. If something changes you hear it from us first, not after.

Our own team

The people who quote the job are the people who do it. Nothing gets handed off to a stranger.

A price that holds

You get a written price with the work spelled out. No surprise extras halfway through.

Tidy site, every day

Scaffold kept safe, debris cleared and your drive left as we found it when we leave.

Guaranteed workmanship
